boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct UAH settings for independent work, group preparation, tutoring, and project-focused study.

cards.title: Salmon Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Reserve for a team session when you need a whiteboard, computer, and wall-mounted monitor; collect the room at User Services with matching photo ID.
cards.short_summary: A reservable group-work setup with shared display and whiteboard tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Salmon Library has five group study rooms seating four to eight; each includes a table, chairs, whiteboard, computer, and wall-mounted monitor.
cards.access_notes: UAH email is required for reservations; bookings are up to three hours and rooms are collected from User Services with photo ID.

cards.title: Salmon Library Smaller Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Use the smaller-room option for a contained work block; reserve with a UAH email or ask in the first-floor lobby about same-day walk-up availability.
cards.short_summary: A reservable smaller-room alternative inside Salmon Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Salmon Library has eight smaller study rooms in addition to its five group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Reservations require a UAH email; same-day walk-ups are first come, first served through the First Floor Lobby.

cards.title: Sensory Space
cards.subtitle: Salmon Library, LIB 210
cards.notes: Choose this second-floor room for a low-stimulation reset between work blocks; use its comfortable seating and non-fluorescent lighting to regroup.
cards.short_summary: A quiet sensory-regulation room with varied seating and softer lighting.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sensory Space is in LIB 210 on Salmon Library's second floor and offers comfortable seating, soft non-fluorescent lights, and calming activities.
cards.access_notes: UAH students, faculty, and staff may use the space; check the linked Sensory Space guide for current procedures.

cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Salmon Library, 1st Floor North
cards.notes: Bring a question or draft to a scheduled or drop-in support session, and use the center’s tutoring, coaching, PASS, or writing-tutoring programs.
cards.short_summary: Academic-support hub offering peer-led one-on-one and group learning sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Success Center, located on Salmon Library's first-floor north side, offers peer-led academic support through one-on-one and group sessions.
cards.access_notes: Services and hours vary by term; the official page provides current drop-in scheduling and appointment links.

cards.entity_name: Conference Training Center Collaborative Learning Spaces
cards.title: Conference Training Center Collaborative Learning Spaces
cards.subtitle: Conference Training Center, 1410 Ben Graves Drive
cards.notes: Work in the CTC’s collaborative learning areas when you need a campus building that combines project space with nearby Charger Cafe and Charger Brew.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative learning areas inside the campus Conference Training Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH states that the Conference Training Center contains numerous collaborative learning spaces, along with Charger Cafe and Charger Brew.
cards.access_notes: The CTC is at 1410 Ben Graves Drive; confirm room availability or event activity before settling in.

cards.title: Charger Union Conference Room 220
cards.subtitle: Charger Union, Room 220
cards.notes: Plan a compact four-person work meeting here when a reservable room and presentation-ready connections would help your group stay organized.
cards.short_summary: A small Charger Union conference room sized for four people.
cards.evidence_claim: Charger Union Room 220 is a small conference room with capacity for four; conference-room use includes flat-screen TVs, speakers, and laptop connections.
cards.source_title: UAH Charger Union: Explore the CU
cards.access_notes: The Charger Union directs users to Event Services to schedule rooms; reservations are subject to availability.

cards.title: Charger Union Conference Room 221
cards.subtitle: Charger Union, Room 221
cards.notes: Reserve this four-person room for a focused partner or small-team planning session, using the installed screen and laptop connection for shared material.
cards.short_summary: A second small conference-room option in the Charger Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Charger Union Room 221 is a small conference room with capacity for four; conference-room use includes flat-screen TVs, speakers, and laptop connections.
cards.source_title: UAH Charger Union: Explore the CU
cards.access_notes: Schedule through Charger Union Event Services; the university notes that room reservations are subject to availability.

cards.title: Charger Union Conference Room 228
cards.subtitle: Charger Union, Room 228
cards.notes: Set up an eight-person working session here when you need a medium conference-room footprint and built-in support for a shared laptop presentation.
cards.short_summary: A medium conference room for groups of up to eight.
cards.evidence_claim: Charger Union Room 228 is a medium conference room with capacity for eight; conference-room use includes flat-screen TVs, speakers, and laptop connections.
cards.source_title: UAH Charger Union: Explore the CU
cards.access_notes: Schedule through Charger Union Event Services; availability and reservation terms apply.

cards.title: Charger Union Conference Room 232
cards.subtitle: Charger Union, Room 232
cards.notes: Use this medium room for an eight-person project review, connecting a laptop to the installed room technology when your materials need a shared screen.
cards.short_summary: A medium meeting room with an eight-person capacity.
cards.evidence_claim: Charger Union Room 232 is a medium conference room with capacity for eight; conference-room use includes flat-screen TVs, speakers, and laptop connections.
cards.source_title: UAH Charger Union: Explore the CU
cards.access_notes: Schedule through Charger Union Event Services; availability and reservation terms apply.

cards.title: Charger Union Conference Room 233
cards.subtitle: Charger Union, Room 233
cards.notes: Book this medium room for a group work session that benefits from a shared display, speakers, and simple laptop connections for collaborative review.
cards.short_summary: An eight-person Charger Union conference-room option.
cards.evidence_claim: Charger Union Room 233 is a medium conference room with capacity for eight; conference-room use includes flat-screen TVs, speakers, and laptop connections.
cards.source_title: UAH Charger Union: Explore the CU
cards.access_notes: Schedule through Charger Union Event Services; availability and reservation terms apply.
